description: Declared public names that were deliberately retired from src/, domain/ and scripts/. Append-only: an entry is never deleted, because the gate reads this file to explain every name that disappeared between two revisions. The one exception is a "*" entry whose module has come back -- it is then false, and the gate only lets it be dropped, never rewritten. See docs/GUARDRAILS.md section B.

retirements.name: upsert_note_kv
retirements.reason: Note-key/value upsert retired with the note-as-fact path: exp/multiplier are no longer written into note, because facts live in structured keys; merge_note is the surviving note writer.

retirements.name: STRICT_MIN_DTE
retirements.reason: The fixed 14-day minimum was retired when Close Advice switched to remaining annualized return with a positive DTE requirement.

retirements.name: STRICT_MIN_REMAINING_TERM_RATIO
retirements.reason: The first-half-of-contract gate was retired because opening term no longer determines the remaining yield decision.

retirements.name: STRICT_MAX_CLOSE_COST_TO_STRIKE_RATIO
retirements.reason: The strike-notional close-cost ceiling was replaced by the Put or Call capital-basis remaining annualized return calculation.

retirements.name: STRICT_MAX_SPREAD_RATIO
retirements.reason: The spread percentage ceiling was retired; a valid two-sided quote is now evaluated at its ask price with fees.

retirements.name: MAX_LOG_FILE_BYTES
retirements.reason: Whole-file rejection was retired because runtime logs now read only a bounded tail regardless of file size.

retirements.name: resolve_holdings_account

retirements.name: is_trusted_global_holdings_context
